# ADR-016: Retain persistent source partition ownership in the existing bubble tracker

Status: chosen_for_spherical_partition_slice

Concerns: Q-state, Q-behavior, Q-reproduce, Q-evidence

## Decision

Extend Tracking with unbounded leaf/parent/primary ownership and source master counter/neighbor transitions. Reuse the existing partition arithmetic through AST exposure of modifiers, and preserve lifecycle/snapshot state. All new behavior is generated from typed source rules.

## Rationale

A GetBallBox query must observe mMyBox and immediate setter/lifetime effects. Recomputing from current coordinates loses source stale ownership and shared-box history. Existing Rust extreme finite coordinates exceed the Original defined integer conversion domain; retain them with an explicit undefined partition marker.

## Alternatives

Duplicate a spatial world; compute boxes at query time; impose bounded proof-model storage on runtime objects.

## Consequences

Both Original fixtures and 82 independent fixed-object C++ transitions pass in the real headless world. Dynamic/static/full-history/active-box/object/order and required proof gates remain open. Generation stages all guarded outputs to prevent partial replacement.
